svg.title: Comparator response to a noisy input

cc:Work.dc:title: Comparator response to a noisy input
cc:Work.dc:description: Qualitative illustration of the same noisy rising input applied to two ideal comparators. A single zero threshold gives repeated output transitions. Two separated thresholds give one transition at the upper threshold. The noise remains on the input.
